name: fortunaterra
description: FortunaTerra's public Claude Code skills for governed agentic delivery: a goal contract written before code, an independent review panel before the PR, and a heuristic usability review of what shipped.

plugins.name: multi-persona-review-panel
plugins.description: Run three or four independent reviewer lenses (architecture, security, quality, performance) on your diff before the PR; each returns findings with file and line and a SIGN / SIGN-WITH-CHANGE / BLOCK verdict.

plugins.name: usability-heuristic-review
plugins.description: Heuristic evaluation of an already-shipped UI surface: Nielsen's ten heuristics, a severity on every finding, a cross-surface coherence audit, and a persona-resonance check. Findings report only, never a redesign.

plugins.name: governed-build-loop
plugins.description: Write a goal contract before touching code: goal, acceptance predicates, pin policy, budget, a spine/slices/waves decomposition, a do-not list, an evidence contract, and an independent review of the contract itself.
